definitions.explanation: The process of expelling used air or gas, or the expelled gas itself. Most commonly refers to vehicle exhaust or building ventilation systems.

examples.japanese: {排気|はいき}ガス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{排気|はいき}⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}した→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧。
examples.english: The ventilation system inside the tunnel broke down.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排気量|はいきりょう}→排気量：18363_haikiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2000ccだ。
examples.english: This car has an engine displacement of 2000cc.

notes: Common compounds: {排気|はいき}ガス (exhaust gas/fumes), ⟦{排気量|はいきりょう}→排気量：18363_haikiryou⟧ (engine displacement, measured in cc or liters), {排気口|はいきこう} (exhaust vent), {排気管|はいきかん} (exhaust pipe). The opposite is ⟦{吸気|きゅうき}→吸気：23963_kyuuki⟧ (intake/inhalation). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{廃棄|はいき}→廃棄：12482_haiki⟧ (disposal/discarding). ⟦{排気量|はいきりょう}→排気量：18363_haikiryou⟧ is an important specification when buying a car in Japan, as it affects road tax rates.
